adm_notice: Boosts are free during launch — the Boosts tab shows which listings are boosted right now. Orange badges on Verifications and Reports mean someone is waiting on you.
adm_doc_hint: Tap a document to open it full size. Compare the face to the ID and the name to the ownership document.
adm_no_verif_d: Landlord verification requests will appear here.
approved_toast: Approved — the landlord is now verified
adm_no_boosts_d: Free launch boosts will appear here as landlords use them.
adm_del_listing_d: It will be wiped completely — the listing, its photos and every chat about it. It will NOT remain on any list, and the report closes with it. This cannot be undone.
adm_del_user_d: The user and everything they own will be wiped — their listings, photos and all their chats. They will NOT remain on the list. This cannot be undone.
setup_tag: One-time setup — secure your platform before renters and landlords join.
setup_sub: This page only works once — the first account created here becomes the platform Admin. Do this right after deploying.
welc_sk_sub: Your account is ready — here is how to find a house safely.
welc_ll_sub: Your account is ready — here is how to rent out fast and safe.
welc_scam_t: Never send money before you SEE the house.
welc_scam_d: No deposit, no booking fee, no reservation — nothing. Visit the house first, then pay the landlord directly.
welc_g1: Search — type a city or country in the search bar, or tap Use my location to see vacant houses nearest to you first.
welc_g2: Open & compare — check the photos, rent, deposit, water and electricity on every listing before you chat.
welc_g3: Chat — message the landlord in the app or on WhatsApp. Ask anything — when to view, what is included.
welc_g4: Visit & view — go see the house in daylight, ideally with a friend. A real landlord will welcome this.
welc_g5: Pay only after viewing — deposit and rent go directly to the landlord, never through HuntIn.
welc_f1: Anyone rushing you to send money for a house you have not seen.
welc_f2: “Pay first to book” stories, or rent too cheap for that area.
welc_f3: Refusing a video call or a physical viewing.
welc_report: See a fake listing? Open it and tap Report — every report is reviewed by the admin.
welc_ll_t: Your 4 steps to renting out faster
welc_l1: Get verified — Profile → verification: upload your ID and an ownership photo. The admin approves it, you earn the green badge and 5 listings instead of 2. Renters trust the badge — verified landlords get more chats.
welc_l2: Post your house — tap Post a new listing: 8 quick steps. Pick the country & city, pin your exact gate on the map, add 3+ clear daylight photos.
welc_l3: Boost free — one tap pins your listing at the top for {n} days for every renter browsing your country. Free while HuntIn is new.
welc_l4: Reply fast — houses whose landlord answers quickly rent much faster. Chats land in your Chats tab.
welc_ll_note: Be the landlord renters trust: never ask for money before a viewing, and meet tenants at the house in daylight. HuntIn never collects money on your behalf.
ll_only_d: Only landlord accounts can post listings. Create a landlord account to list your rooms.
boost_target_hint: Boosts are targeted to the country — renters browsing {c} see boosted houses on top.
units_hint: Renters see exactly how many units are vacant — start with all of them vacant, then update the count anytime in My listings as houses fill.
landmark_ph: e.g. opposite the mall, near the metro station
pin_exact_t: Pin the exact spot on Google Maps
pin_exact_d: Drag the red pin to your compound gate — or tap the map and the pin jumps there. This is the same Google map renters see on your listing. Switch to Satellite to see houses and gates clearly.
terms_ph: e.g. Rent due by 5th of the month. One month deposit.
prepaid_hint: Prepaid meter? Leave the cost empty — each tenant tops up their own meter.
wifi_prov_ph: e.g. Starlink, Jio, Comcast, local ISP
pref_hint: Who the house suits best — leave as Anyone if there is no preference
avail_hint: Pick "Available now" if the room is vacant today.
phone_priv: Your number is only shown to signed-in users. HuntIn never collects any payment on your behalf.
photos_l: Photos (3–8) — first photo is the cover
photos_hint: Photos are compressed in your browser before upload. Add clear daylight photos — listings with good photos get 3× more chats.
editing_hint: Editing — jump to any section above and save from there. No need to walk through all 8 steps.
v_title: Give your listing a title (at least 4 characters)
v_phone: Add a valid contact phone number
spot_pinned: Spot pinned — renters will see this exact spot on the map.
spot_tip: Tip: pick the country & city on Step 1 so renters can find it.
geo_unsupported: Geolocation is not supported on this device
loc_fail: Could not get your location — check location permission
place_nf2: Place not found — try the map or GPS instead
map_load_fail: Map could not load — check your internet connection and reopen this step.
boost_owner_only: Only the owner can boost this listing.
boosted_until_c: This listing is boosted until {d} — renters browsing {c} see it at the top.
boost_what_d: Your listing jumps to the top of results in {c} with an orange BOOSTED badge for {n} days — on the home page, search results and the map for everyone browsing {c}. Renters in other countries are not affected unless they search {c} themselves. Boosted listings get the most views and chats.
boost_free_d: No payment, no code — boosts are free while HuntIn is new. One tap and it is live.
boost_safety: Rent and deposits are NEVER paid through this platform — always view the house first.
map_fail_d: Check your internet connection and refresh.
pv_store_d: Your username, name, phone/WhatsApp number, role, and — for landlords — the verification documents you upload. Listing photos and details you post. Chat messages you send. Nothing else. No email, no tracking pixels.
pv_seen_d: Listing content is public. Your phone number is shown to signed-in users on your listings and in chats so renters can reach you. Your verification documents are only visible to the admin. Chats are only visible to you and the other person. If you share your location, it stays on your device — it is never sent to our servers.
pv_rule_d: HuntIn never collects rent, deposit, or any payment. All money matters happen face-to-face after a viewing. If anyone asks you to pay through the app or before a viewing, report them.
pv_data_d: We collect the minimum data needed to run the service. You may ask for your data to be deleted at any time — contact the site admin.
map_empty_d: Pinned houses will appear here — try a bigger radius or another city.
allow_loc_first: Allow location first — tap "Use my location" on the home page
cta_boost_d: free during launch: one tap pins a listing at the top for {n} days for every renter browsing your country. Free while HuntIn is new.
qr2: Can I view it this weekend?
qr3: What is the total monthly cost?
qr4: Is water included in the rent?
qr6: When would you like to come for viewing?
geo_no_browser: Your browser does not support location
loc_denied: Location permission denied — choose your town below instead
